-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER','EDS','EDS','DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER','DEP',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime);GO


-----insert data in om task dependency table
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_DW_DEPOSITS_FACT','TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER'; GO
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_EDS_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP','TSK_EDS_DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER'; GO
